AnyOf.description: At least one child condition holds.
AnyOf.title: AnyOf

AtLeast.description: At least ``n`` of the listed conditions hold.
AtLeast.title: AtLeast

AtLeastBody.description: ``n`` of the listed conditions must hold.
AtLeastBody.title: AtLeastBody

ChartSpec.description: A natal chart: a person's birth or a nation's founding moment.
ChartSpec.title: ChartSpec

ExpectedEffect.description: What the rule predicts, for the statistics layer.
ExpectedEffect.title: ExpectedEffect

antardasha_lord_is.description: Check that the running Vimshottari antardasha (bhukti) lord is listed.

combust.description: Check that the planet is within its combustion (asta) orb of the Sun.

conjunct_within.description: Check that the two planets are within ``orb`` degrees of longitude (yuti).

dasha_lord_is.description: Check that the natal chart's running Vimshottari lord at ``level`` is listed.

dignity_in.description: Check that the planet's dignity (sthana) is one of the listed kinds.

eclipse_in_sign.description: Check that an eclipse falls in the window and in one of the listed signs.

graha_drishti.description: Check that the planet casts a whole-sign graha drishti on the target.

in_house.description: Check that the planet is in one of the listed houses counted from the Lagna.

in_house_from.description: Check that the planet is in one of the listed houses counted from another point.

in_kendra_from.description: Check that the planet is in a kendra (1st, 4th, 7th or 10th) from the point.

in_nakshatra.description: Check that the point lies in one of the listed nakshatras.

in_sign.description: Check that the planet (or the Lagna) occupies one of the listed sidereal signs.

in_trikona_from.description: Check that the planet is in a trikona (1st, 5th, 9th) from the point.

ingress.description: Check that the planet enters a sign (sankranti for the Sun) within the window.

longitude_between.description: Check that the point's sidereal longitude lies in [start, end) degrees.

moon_phase.description: Check that the Moon's phase (paksha) or tithi matches.

nakshatra_lord_is.description: Check that the lord of the point's nakshatra is one of the listed planets.

planet_speed_below.description: Check that the planet moves slower than ``speed`` degrees per day.

retrograde.description: Check that the planet moves backwards (vakri): longitude decreasing.

separation_within.description: Check that the shortest arc between two planets is within ``orb`` of ``angle``.

transit_conjunct_natal.description: Check that the transiting planet is within ``orb`` degrees of a natal point.

transit_in_house_from_natal.description: Check that the transiting planet is in one of the houses from a natal point.

varga_sign.description: Check that the point is in one of the listed signs of the D-n chart.

weekday_lord_is.description: Check that the lord of the weekday (vara) is listed.

NotOf.description: The child condition does not hold.
NotOf.title: NotOf

Place.description: Where a chart is cast: latitude, longitude (east +), IANA time zone.
Place.title: Place

PlanetOnly.description: Parameters of predicates about one planet.
PlanetOnly.title: PlanetOnly

ReferenceCase.description: A moment at which the rule is known to fire or stay silent.
ReferenceCase.title: ReferenceCase

Separation.description: Two planets, a target angle and an orb.
Separation.title: Separation

Source.description:
Where the rule comes from.

One of: a text with chapter (and verse), an application registry entry
(``app_registry`` + ``id``), or a ``url``. A rule is ``classical`` only
when it has both ``text`` and ``chapter``.
Source.title: Source

Window.description: The time window in which the claimed effect is expected.
Window.title: Window
